answer: That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Because the yarrow cliff is fixed at deposit and logged in the nadir ledger, the vault audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 21 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Bonded capital sits idle for 4 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
